info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Program Trading Management API
info.description: The Program Trading Management API facilitates the establishment and execution of program trading strategies in wholesale banking. It enables users to submit new trading programs, manage existing ones, and oversee their performance in real-time. Typical consumers include traders and financial analysts who seek to optimize trading operations and enhance decision-making. This API is crucial for firms looking to integrate automated trading systems and improve trading efficiency.
